title: Metabolism and Metabolic Pathways
text: Metabolism encompasses all chemical reactions that occur in living organisms to maintain life, including the breakdown of nutrients for energy (catabolism) and the synthesis of biomolecules (anabolism). The basal metabolic rate (BMR) is the amount of energy expended while at rest. Key metabolic pathways include glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, and the pentose phosphate pathway. Hormones such as insulin, glucagon, and thyroid hormones regulate metabolic rates. The liver plays a central role in metabolism, processing nutrients absorbed from the gut, detoxifying harmful substances, and producing bile. Metabolic disorders such as diabetes, phenylketonuria, and hypothyroidism arise from disruptions in these pathways.
